name: @amartinr/pi-bifrost-reasoning-fix
description: Pi extension that fixes the DeepSeek-behind-Bifrost reasoning drop on tool-calling turns. Bifrost relays DeepSeek reasoning in non-standard fields (reasoning / reasoning_details instead of reasoning_content); in tool-calling contexts DeepSeek requires rea
